description: This Java source file defines the CommandHandlerWrapper class, which encapsulates command handling logic for a device within a command consumer architecture. It manages device and gateway identifiers, delegates command handling, and handles remote close events.

classes.name: CommandHandlerWrapper
classes.description: A final class that wraps command handlers and associated metadata for specific devices and gateways, enabling command processing and remote close handling.

methods.name: CommandHandlerWrapper
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the CommandHandlerWrapper with device ID, optional gateway ID, command handler, and optional remote close handler.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device identifier this wrapper is handling.

methods.name: getGatewayId
methods.description: Returns the gateway identifier associated with the device, or null if none.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Delegates handling of a command context to the encapsulated command handler.

methods.name: handleRemoteClose
methods.description: Invokes the remote close handler if it is defined to handle cleanup when the command consumer is closed remotely.
